audited_structural_model.variable: one concrete placement/path assignment per nondegenerate staging tensor
audited_structural_model.objective_factor: one tensor-owned link-service event sum per variable
audited_structural_model.physical_event_ownership: each link-service event belongs to exactly one staging tensor factor

classification.SEPARABLE: all factors are unary; induced width is zero and independent argmin is exact
classification.COUPLED_NOT_SOLVED: at least one non-unary factor exists; this census does not benchmark VE
